name: MemoMind Smart Glasses
description: Normalize and dispatch MemoMind smart-glasses control requests to a paired OpenClaw node.

defaultNodeId.label: Default Node ID
defaultNodeId.help: Used when a command or tool call omits nodeId.

nodeCommand.label: Node Command
nodeCommand.help: The node command declared by the mobile app. Default: memomind.control

allowNodeIds.label: Allowed Node IDs
allowNodeIds.help: Optional safety allowlist. If set, only these node ids can receive glasses commands.
